english.title: Superintendent registrar issue certificate for marriage when conditions in section 31(3) were not met
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a superintendent registrar, knowingly and wilfully issued a marriage schedule of **(..SPECIFY THE PARTIES TO THE MARRIAGE..) when none of the conditions in sections 31(3) of the Marriage Act 1949 had been met
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 31(3) and 75(3)(a) of the Marriage Act 1949.
english.pointstoprove:

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: The term 'marriage schedule' replaced the term 'certificates of a superintendent registrar' from the 4th May 2021 by the Marriage Regulations 2021. For offences which occur before this date, please see H15905.
